moreswitchtracker.switch.campfire_smoke_: Campfires stop smoking; flames and cooking are unaffected.
moreswitchtracker.switch.carpet_fake_pla: Sets Carpet so /player works in survival. Reload the world to apply.
moreswitchtracker.switch.drop_key_lock.d: Q no longer drops an item, and Ctrl+Q no longer drops the stack.
moreswitchtracker.switch.effect_particle: Hides potion particles only; the effect itself is unchanged.
moreswitchtracker.switch.firework_cooldo: A rocket use is followed by a 3 second cooldown, so rapid clicks waste none.
moreswitchtracker.switch.fullscreen_key_: F11 no longer toggles fullscreen; the button in video settings still works.
moreswitchtracker.switch.light_preview.d: Holding a light source, shows cyan light levels on nearby block tops.
moreswitchtracker.switch.minecart_sound_: Removes the rolling noise and the muffled sound while riding.
moreswitchtracker.switch.moving_light.de: Held light brightens nearby blocks; no effect with Sodium/Iris - remove them to use it.
moreswitchtracker.switch.piston_sound_of: Removes the piston extend and contract sounds.
moreswitchtracker.switch.rain_sleep.desc: While it rains, a bed works in daylight and skips to the next day.
moreswitchtracker.switch.rain_sleep.name: Sleep Through Rain
moreswitchtracker.switch.resource_pack_w: No warning or confirmation when enabling a version-mismatched pack.
moreswitchtracker.switch.tnt_sound_off.d: Removes the explosion boom; TNT and other explosions share this sound.
moreswitchtracker.switch.totem_refill.de: Keeps a totem of undying in your offhand until you run out.
moreswitchtracker.switch.tutorial_off.de: No tutorial prompts, and no new-recipe reminders either.
moreswitchtracker.switch.window_lock.des: No resize arrow on the edges; the size is fixed, but the window still moves.
moreswitchtracker.tooltip.window_lock_on: Window size locked; position is unaffected. Turn the switch off to restore.
tracker.module.custom_coord_tracking.des: Type a coordinate and keep highlighting it until switched off; the point is remembered
tracker.module.dragon_aggro_tracking.des: A blue ray from the ender dragon to the player it is after
tracker.module.elite_mob_tracking.desc: Spot mobs with far more health than usual, with coordinates and a 10-minute highlight
tracker.module.elite_mob_tracking.name: Elite Mob Tracking
tracker.module.end_gateway_tracking.desc: In the End, marks the nearest end gateway for 10 minutes; flip off and on to repeat
tracker.module.end_gateway_tracking.name: End Gateway Tracker
tracker.module.lag_source_tracking.desc: Find the top MSPT consumers with coordinates; type #L id or /tracker lag to list and highlight
tracker.module.lag_source_tracking.name: Entity Lag Source Tracking
tracker.module.legacy_tracking.desc: Death coordinates, a 5-minute x-ray highlight, and drop tracking
tracker.module.legacy_tracking.name: Legacy Tracking
tracker.module.mob_glow_tracking.desc: Every hostile mob within 128 blocks gets the spectral-arrow outline for 2 minutes
tracker.module.mob_glow_tracking.name: Mob Glow
tracker.module.persistent_mob_tracking.d: Find mobs that will never despawn
tracker.module.player_tracking.desc: Type @ in chat to pick a player and highlight them for 10 minutes
tracker.module.player_tracking.name: Player Tracking
tracker.module.villager_poi_tracking.des: Rays from each villager to its claimed bed (blue) and workstation (red)
tracker.module.wandering_trader_tracking: Chat alert with coordinates, a 10-minute highlight and the despawn countdown
tracker.module.zombie_aggro_tracking.des: A red ray from every zombie-family mob to its attack target
